fields.Name: Sales: Won Deals With Unconfirmed Orders
fields.UserQuestion: Which won deals have an order that was never confirmed, and so will never be billed?
fields.Description: Finance exception review (golive #279, type 3): every won deal whose order is still not Confirmed, including a voided order and a deal with no order. Closing a deal Won does not confirm its order, and nothing else says when that step never happens. Run at month end until the nightly exception check replaces it.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Grain: Deal. Won is DealStatusType.IsWon. The order is reached through Deal.OrderID and read from __mj_BizAppsOrders.vwOrderHeaders; a deal qualifies when the order is missing or its Status is not Confirmed. Date dimension: ActualCloseDate, falling back to the date part of ClosedAt. DaysSinceClose counts to __mj_BizAppsCommon.fnBusinessToday(). Optional parameters: CompanyID; MinDaysSinceClose (grace period, omitted = no grace); PeriodStart/PeriodEnd bound the close date inclusively.
